calculation.description: Cross-asset contrarian signal: assets with poor recent returns relative to their own medium-term volatility receive higher scores. Uses closes available through the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: 10d ICIR is positive over the full sample; 5d and 20d IC are also positive. Signal was tested on 15 tradable cross-asset instruments with at least 8 valid names per date. Regime subperiod breakdown was not computed for this candidate; interpret uncertainty conservatively given small cross-sections.
